name: Vịt om sấu
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Vietnamese Vịt Om Sấu (Northern Vietnamese Duck Braised with Dracontomelon). Tender succulent duck pieces braised with round green dracontomelon fruits (sấu) and chunks of soft taro in a fragrant, golden savory herb broth. Served steaming hot in a traditional dark rustic ceramic clay pot. Garnished generously with fresh finely sliced sawtooth coriander (ngò gai) and aromatic herbs. Beside the pot are fresh white vermicelli rice noodles (bún), chili slices, and lime on a dark weathered wooden tabletop. Soft cinematic side lighting, photorealistic textures, 8k resolution.

name: Canh cua mồng tơi cà pháo
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of traditional Northern Vietnamese Crab and Malabar Spinach Soup with Pickled White Eggplants (Canh cua mồng tơi cà pháo). A rustic glazed ceramic bowl of vibrant green Malabar spinach (rau mồng tơi) and jute leaves (rau đay) in a steaming freshwater crab broth with thick golden clusters of crab roe (riêu cua) floating on top. Beside the soup bowl sits a small ceramic bowl of crunchy ivory-white salted eggplants (cà pháo muối) and a bowl of steaming jasmine rice. Dark rustic wooden background, bright natural morning light, 8k resolution.

name: Cá kho làng Vũ Đại
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of legendary Vietnamese Dai Hoang Braised Black Carp (Cá kho làng Vũ Đại). A traditional handcrafted terracotta clay pot containing thick, firm steaks of black carp braised for 16 hours into a deep dark mahogany-red glaze, seasoned with crushed galangal (riềng), ginger, fresh chilies, pork belly, and lime juice. The fish flesh is tender yet firm with completely softened bones. Garnished with golden galangal slices on a dark rustic wooden table, cozy warm evening lighting, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo Đà Nẵng
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Da Nang Pork Belly Rice Paper Rolls (Bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo Đà Nẵng). A large round bamboo platter featuring neatly sliced boiled pork belly with two distinct layers of rind and fat (thịt heo hai đầu da). Accompanied by a stack of translucent dew-soaked rice paper, a mountain of fresh wild herbs, cucumber spears, green mango ribbons, and starfruit. In the center is a dipping bowl of pungent, savory-sweet fermented anchovy sauce (mắm nêm) garnished with minced pineapple and chili. Warm directional lighting, 8k resolution.

name: Cơm lam gà nướng Tây Nguyên
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Central Highlands Grilled Chicken with Bamboo Tube Sticky Rice (Cơm lam gà nướng Tây Nguyên). A whole free-range chicken roasted over red charcoal embers, golden blistered crispy skin glistening with wild forest honey and crushed lemongrass. Cut open alongside charred green bamboo cylinders revealing fragrant, steaming sticky rice cakes (cơm lam) with toasted crust. Served on banana leaves with wild herb salt (muối é rừng) and fresh lime. Rustic wooden slab tabletop, warm fire glow, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh hỏi cháo lòng Bình Định
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Binh Dinh Woven Rice Vermicelli with Pork Offal Congee (Bánh hỏi cháo lòng Bình Định). Delicate, lacy woven white rice vermicelli bundles brushed with aromatic scallion oil (mỡ hành), served next to a platter of tender sliced boiled pork liver, heart, intestines, and pork belly. Accompanied by a steaming bowl of savory pork broth rice porridge and a saucer of pure fish sauce with chopped bird's eye chilies. Dark rustic wood table, natural soft morning light, 8k resolution.

name: Lẩu cua đồng miền Tây
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Mekong Delta Freshwater Crab Hot Pot (Lẩu cua đồng miền Tây). A central stainless steel pot simmering with rich reddish-orange crab broth brimming with fluffy golden crab meat paste, ripe tomato wedges, fried tofu puffs, and river prawns. Surrounding the pot is a colorful wicker basket loaded with fresh water spinach, water lily stems (bông súng), Malabar spinach, banana blossoms, and fresh vermicelli. Rising steam, rustic river delta wooden table, 8k resolution.

name: Bún kèn Kiên Giang
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Kien Giang Fish Coconut Milk Noodle Soup (Bún kèn Kiên Giang). An artisanal ceramic bowl of soft white rice vermicelli drenched in a rich, velvety, golden turmeric-spiced coconut broth simmered with finely shredded fresh sea fish meat and lemongrass. Garnished on top with crisp julienned green papaya, cucumber, bean sprouts, fresh basil, and a spoonful of red chili sambal. Rustic wooden table, bright tropical morning daylight, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh tằm bì nước cốt dừa
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Southern Vietnamese Silkworm Rice Noodles with Shredded Pork and Coconut Cream (Bánh tằm bì nước cốt dừa). Thick, chewy, hand-rolled white rice noodles served on a ceramic plate, topped with golden seasoned shredded pork skin (bì), fresh cucumber, fragrant Vietnamese herbs, pickled carrots, and a drizzle of rich, thick savory-sweet white coconut cream and golden garlic fish sauce. Vibrant street food presentation, dark wood background, 8k resolution.

name: Lẩu vịt nấu chao Cần Thơ
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Can Tho Duck Hot Pot with Fermented Bean Curd (Lẩu vịt nấu chao Cần Thơ). A simmering metal hotpot with succulent braised duck pieces and starchy taro chunks in a rich, creamy, reddish broth infused with fragrant red fermented tofu (chao đỏ). Served with a basket of fresh water spinach and a dipping bowl of creamy chao sauce blended with chili, garlic, and sugar. Steaming hot, cozy dinner lighting on a rustic wooden table, 8k resolution.

name: Bún bề bề Hạ Long
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Ha Long Mantis Shrimp Noodle Soup (Bún bề bề Hạ Long). A large steaming ceramic bowl filled with sweet savory seafood broth made from dried shrimp and mantis shrimp shells. Filled with rice vermicelli, topped with succulent whole peeled steamed mantis shrimp (bề bề bóc nõn), golden fried squid cakes (chả mực), grilled tomatoes, and green water spinach. Garnished with scallions and perilla leaves on a dark wooden table, rising steam, 8k resolution.

name: Bún đũa Nam Định
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Nam Dinh Chopstick Noodle Soup (Bún đũa Nam Định). A steaming bowl of unusually thick, round, chewy rice noodles the size of chopsticks, bathed in a rich, sweet, and sour freshwater crab broth. Heaped high with fluffy golden crab roe (riêu cua), crunchy blanched water spinach, bean sprouts, and crispy fried shallots with chili oil. Rustic terracotta bowl on a weathered wooden table, 8k resolution.

name: Cơm cháy sốt thịt dê Ninh Bình
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Ninh Binh Crispy Rice with Mountain Goat Meat Sauce (Cơm cháy sốt thịt dê Ninh Bình). Golden, blistered, ultra-crunchy squares of toasted glutinous rice crackling piled high on a rustic plate, served beside a steaming bowl of savory stewed mountain goat meat in a glossy, rich brown sauce sautéed with onions, carrots, and wild herbs. Dark wooden table, warm appetizing lighting, 8k resolution.

name: Bún thang lươn Hưng Yên
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Hung Yen Eel Noodle Soup (Bún thang lươn Hưng Yên). A magnificent ceramic bowl of clear pork bone broth poured over rice vermicelli, artfully topped with crispy deep-fried freshwater eel pieces, shredded boiled chicken, thinly sliced golden fried egg strips, julienned Vietnamese ham (giò lụa), and a touch of shrimp paste with fresh Vietnamese coriander (rau răm). Dark wooden surface, gourmet editorial styling, 8k resolution.

name: Canh cá Quỳnh Côi
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Thai Binh Quynh Coi Fish Soup (Canh cá Quỳnh Côi). A steaming bowl containing soft chewy flat rice crepes in a crystal-clear, delicate fish bone broth. Loaded with golden pan-fried tender snakehead fish nuggets, seasonal mustard greens (rau cải canh), fresh dill, and finely sliced ginger. Steam rising gracefully, rustic dark wooden table background, 8k resolution.

name: Gà đồi Yên Thế hấp lá chanh
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Bac Giang Yen The Free-Range Chicken Steamed with Lime Leaves (Gà đồi Yên Thế hấp lá chanh). Slices of tender, juicy steamed chicken with glossy golden crispy skin, neatly arranged on a banana leaf platter, scattered with paper-thin chiffonade of fresh fragrant kaffir lime leaves. Served alongside a small saucer of crushed sea salt, ground black pepper, fresh red chili, and lime juice. Natural directional lighting, 8k resolution.

name: Cá thính Lập Thạch chiên giòn
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Vinh Phuc Lap Thach Fermented Roasted Cornmeal Fish (Cá thính Lập Thạch chiên giòn). Golden-brown, pan-fried fish steaks encrusted in fragrant toasted corn and soybean meal, releasing an intoxicating smoky, slightly sour and savory aroma. Placed on an artisanal clay plate with fresh red chili slices and herbs, served with steaming jasmine rice. Dark vintage wooden table, 8k resolution.

name: Cá lăng nướng than hoa sông Đà
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Phu Tho Grilled Da River Hemibagrus Fish (Cá lăng nướng than hoa sông Đà). Thick, juicy fillets of fresh river catfish marinated in fermented rice (mẻ), fresh turmeric, and galangal, grilled over charcoal with charred edges. Laid out on a bamboo tray lined with banana leaves, topped with grilled scallions and fresh dill. Dipping sauce of whipped shrimp paste with lime on the side, 8k resolution.

name: Gỏi cá bỗng sông Lô
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Tuyen Quang Lo River Fish Salad (Gỏi cá bỗng sông Lô). Translucent paper-thin slices of fresh mountain river carp tossed with crispy roasted fish bone meal (thính xương cá), served on a bed of assorted wild forest leaves. Accompanied by sour starfruit slices, green bananas, and an artisanal ceramic bowl of sweet-tangy herbal dipping sauce. Dark rustic wooden background, 8k resolution.

name: Tôm chua Ba Bể cuốn thịt luộc
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Bac Kan Ba Be Lake Fermented Sour Shrimp Rolls (Tôm chua Ba Bể cuốn thịt luộc). A platter displaying bright red fermented whole freshwater shrimp mixed with garlic and red chili slices, alongside thinly sliced boiled pork belly, crisp cucumber, tart starfruit, and green banana slices. Served with rice paper and fresh mountain herbs on a dark rustic table, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh cuốn canh Cao Bằng
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Cao Bang Steamed Rice Rolls with Savory Bone Broth (Bánh cuốn canh Cao Bằng). Soft, delicate steamed rice rolls filled with savory minced pork, resting on a ceramic dish, served directly beside a hot bowl of rich pork bone broth infused with chopped cilantro, scallions, a soft poached egg, and local steamed pork sausage (giò nạc). Dark wooden table, rising steam, 8k resolution.

name: Vịt quay lá móc mật Lạng Sơn
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Lang Son Roast Duck with Clausena Leaves (Vịt quay lá móc mật Lạng Sơn). A whole roasted duck chopped into succulent pieces, boasting glossy honey-amber lacquered crispy skin, stuffed with aromatic mountain Clausena (mắc mật) leaves and spices. Served with a bowl of rich duck roasting juices blended with wild garlic and chili on a dark rustic wooden table, 8k resolution.

name: Lẩu cá hồi Sa Pa
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Sa Pa Fresh Salmon Hot Pot (Lẩu cá hồi Sa Pa). A steaming communal hotpot with sour and spicy tomato-pineapple broth with lemongrass. Flanked by an exquisite presentation plate of thinly sliced, bright orange fresh salmon fillets and salmon head. Accompanied by a basket of high-altitude crisp mustard greens (cải mèo), mushrooms, and rice noodles. Misty mountain cozy dining ambiance, 8k resolution.

name: Thịt lợn mán nướng Bản Mường
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Hoa Binh Muong Village Grilled Native Pork (Thịt lợn mán nướng Bản Mường). Skewered chunks of tender native wild pork with crispy blistered rind, marinated in crushed wild forest seeds (hạt dổi), lemongrass, and mac khen pepper, grilled over charcoal. Served on a banana leaf with roasted sesame seeds, bamboo sticky rice, and wild salt dip. Dark rustic wooden table, 8k resolution.

name: Gà đen Tủa Chùa nướng mắc khén
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Dien Bien Tua Chua Black Bone Chicken Grilled with Wild Pepper (Gà đen Tủa Chùa nướng mắc khén). A roasted native black-boned, black-skinned chicken glistening over glowing charcoal, spiced with wild mac khen forest pepper and ginger. Cut into pieces on a banana leaf platter, garnished with red mountain chilies and wild herb dipping salt on a rustic wood table, 8k resolution.

name: Pa pỉnh tộp Lai Châu
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Lai Chau Thai Ethnic Grilled Folded Carp (Pa pỉnh tộp Lai Châu). A whole freshwater carp stuffed with herbs, wild pepper (mắc khén), scallions, and ginger, folded in half and held in a split bamboo clamp, charcoal grilled to a crisp golden exterior while retaining juicy, fragrant flesh. Resting on fresh banana leaves with sticky rice and forest dipping sauce, 8k resolution.

name: Nem chua Thanh Hóa nướng
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Thanh Hoa Charcoal-Grilled Fermented Pork Rolls (Nem chua Thanh Hóa nướng). Plump fermented pork rolls slightly charred and caramelized from the grill, unwrapped from scorched banana leaf layers, revealing glistening rosy-pink meat embedded with whole garlic cloves and red bird's eye chilies. Served with a dipping saucer of spicy chili sauce on a dark wood table, 8k resolution.

name: Súp lươn Nghệ An bánh mì
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Nghe An Spicy Freshwater Eel Soup with Baguette (Súp lươn Nghệ An bánh mì). A steaming, vibrant reddish-orange spicy broth loaded with tender, flavorful wok-seared eel strips sautéed with native shallots (hành tăm), fresh turmeric, and chili. Served with warm, golden crispy Vietnamese baguettes (bánh mì giòn), lime wedges, and Vietnamese coriander (rau răm). Dark rustic wood table, rising steam, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh mướt ram giò Hà Tĩnh
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Ha Tinh Steamed Rice Crepes with Crispy Spring Rolls (Bánh mướt ram giò Hà Tĩnh). Silky, translucent, paper-thin steamed rice crepes glistening with shallot oil, served alongside shatteringly crisp deep-fried pork-wood ear spring rolls (ram giòn) and thick slices of steamed pork ham (giò lụa). Dipping bowl of amber garlic-chili lime fish sauce on a rustic dark wooden table, 8k resolution.

name: Thịt trâu xào lá trơng Quảng Trị
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Quang Tri Stir-Fried Water Buffalo Meat with Trong Leaves (Thịt trâu xào lá trơng Quảng Trị). Sizzling tender slices of buffalo meat wok-tossed with pungent, slightly numbing wild green trong leaves and clusters of fresh green peppercorns. Placed on an artisanal ceramic dish, garnished with red chili strips. Dark rustic wooden surface, warm appetizing steam, 8k resolution.

name: Cá lăng nướng đọt mây Đắk Nông
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Dak Nong Grilled River Catfish with Rattan Shoots (Cá lăng nướng đọt mây Đắk Nông). Chunks of rich Serepok river catfish grilled on bamboo skewers with wild forest salt, served with grilled tender rattan shoots (đọt mây nướng) possessing an exquisite sweet-bitter flavor. Presented on a banana leaf with roasted bird's eye chili salt, dark wooden table, 8k resolution.

name: Gà thả vườn nướng đọt mây Bình Phước
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Binh Phuoc Free-Range Chicken Grilled with Rattan Shoots (Gà thả vườn nướng đọt mây Bình Phước). Whole roasted chicken chopped and glistening with crushed cashew nut oil and chili, served beside tender charred rattan shoots and fragrant bamboo tube sticky rice. Banana leaf lining, rustic wooden board, 8k resolution.

name: Gỏi măng cụt gà xé Bình Dương
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Binh Duong Mangosteen Chicken Salad (Gỏi măng cụt gà xé Bình Dương). Crisp floral-shaped slices of tart-sweet green mangosteen fruit tossed with hand-shredded boiled free-range chicken, fragrant Vietnamese coriander (rau răm), crunchy roasted peanuts, and fried shallots, dressed in tangy sweet fish sauce. Artisanal ceramic dish, bright fresh colors, 8k resolution.

name: Gỏi cá Biên Hòa
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Bien Hoa Freshwater Fish Salad (Gỏi cá Biên Hòa). Thin, delicate slices of fresh river fish tossed in toasted golden sesame and roasted rice powder (thính gạo mè), served with a massive bouquet of over twenty varieties of wild medicinal leaves and herbs, accompanied by a bowl of thick, velvety, savory-sweet spiced dipping broth. Dark rustic wood table, 8k resolution.

name: Bún cá Châu Đốc
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Chau Doc Golden Turmeric Fish Noodle Soup (Bún cá Châu Đốc). A large ceramic bowl of glistening golden-yellow broth simmered from freshwater fish bones and wild fingerroot (ngải bún), poured over rice vermicelli. Topped with golden pan-seared snakehead fish fillets seasoned with turmeric, vibrant yellow sesbania flowers (bông điên điển), and fresh bitter herb greens. Steaming hot on a rustic table, 8k resolution.

name: Chả cá thác lác Hậu Giang
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Hau Giang Featherback Fish Cakes (Chả cá thác lác Hậu Giang). Golden-fried, springy, savory patties of pounded bronze featherback fish speckled with black peppercorns and scallions, served steaming hot alongside a platter of paper-thin bitter melon slices and sweet chili dipping sauce. Dark rustic wooden tabletop, natural warm light, 8k resolution.

name: Cua Cà Mau rang me
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of famous Ca Mau Mud Crab Stir-Fried in Tamarind Sauce (Cua Cà Mau rang me). Large, meaty Ca Mau sea crab with deep orange shells, cut in half and generously coated in a thick, glossy, sweet-and-sour mahogany-colored tamarind glaze with fried garlic and red chilies. Garnished with fresh Vietnamese coriander (rau răm) and served with warm, crusty bread (bánh mì) for dipping. Dark wood table, glistening textures, 8k resolution.
